hook: Kullu ke tower mein teen dost nahi... char saaye the!
feedback: Great cold open flash-forward hook and strong twist ending with the 4th face. To push emotion to a 9, build a tiny bit more warmth/relief around Sahil's return in the mid-section before breaking it with the horror reveal. Cut 8 (silent latch insert) works well for visual rhythm.
lines: Kullu ke tower mein teen dost nahi... char saaye the!
Par Kabir ko yeh sach bahut der se pata chala.
Raat teen baje, Kabir aur Dhruv apne dost Sahil ke sath pahunche.
Teen saal pehle khoya Sahil... aaj achanak mila tha.
Tower mein pahunchkar Kabir ne ek selfie li.
Lekin photo dekhte hi saans atak gayi... usmein char chehre the!
Kabir! Darwaza bahar se band hai!
Roshni kone mein padi... Sahil ki aankhen poori kali thin!
Kabir ro pada... Sahil to teen saal pehle hi mar chuka tha!
Yahan se jaane ke liye... ek dost ko chhodna padega.
Raat mein group photo kheenchte waqt gin lena... koi anjana to nahi?
